title: Coordinator handoff v2
goal: A coordinator handoff hands over state, not just a note. Work the outgoing coordinator left running still reaches someone, the successor's conversation starts clean, its first turn costs about 15k fewer tokens, and the owner's rulings survive any number of handoffs as project records instead of prose in a note. Design: docs/coordinator-handoff-v2-design.md; board: docs/mocks/coordinator-handoff-v2/ (owner chose D1 A, D2 A, D3 A on 2026-11-16).
instructions:
Read docs/coordinator-handoff-v2-design.md and the board PNGs in docs/mocks/coordinator-handoff-v2/ first (sparse checkouts: `git sparse-checkout add docs/mocks/coordinator-handoff-v2`). v1's API is in docs/coordinator-handoff.md. The swap transaction is ProjectsService.coordinator in src/apiserver/src/projects/projects.service.ts.

Owner decisions (2026-11-16):
- D1 A: rulings are their own record, project_ruling. Not a section of the instructions.
- D2 A: records from before the successor was created are not drawn in it. The handoff note card carries one line linking to the previous coordinator.
- D3 A: the server writes a dated state digest into the successor's opening, instead of requiring project_get + task_list first.

Rules:
- Every product string is English (CLAUDE.md §5; src/web/src/copyLanguage.test.ts).
- A client-side rule ships in web, iOS/macOS (OrbitKit) and Android with the same behaviour. Name the counterpart on each side in your evidence.
- Run the full web suite before evidence when web changes, not only related files.
- Out of scope: the `<orbit_project_coordinator_context>` block being sent again with slash commands (separate defect); suggesting a handoff at about 55% of the context window; checking the note against moved items; heavy skills as subagents.

acceptanceCriteriaItems.text: Pending work follows a handoff. A `delegate` (SubAgent) run or a `bg_run` job that ends after its coordinator handed over wakes the successor, following a chain of handoffs, instead of being DROPPED. That wake names that the previous coordinator started it. `session_scheduled_wakeup` and `session_wakeup_loop` rows move to the successor in the swap transaction, a loop keeping its schedule. The handoff preview (`GET /projects/:id/coordinator/pending-waits`) and `movedWaits` list each with a kind (WATCH, SUBAGENT, JOB, WAKEUP, LOOP), and the confirm dialog on web, iOS/macOS and Android shows the kind.
acceptanceCriteriaItems.verificationMethod: Apiserver pg specs for each of the four kinds: a wake filed after a COMPLETED handoff lands on the successor (and on the last session in a two-handoff chain), and a session that ended without a handoff still drops it. Swap spec showing wakeup and loop rows moved in the same transaction. Each client's dialog test rendering a SUBAGENT and a WAKEUP row. Reviewer reads the specs and their passing output.

heldUpBy.title: Handoff: forward SubAgent/bg_run wakes and move scheduled wakeups to the successor
Handoff confirm dialog shows each pending item's kind on web, iOS/macOS and Android

acceptanceCriteriaItems.text: A coordinator conversation does not draw a record (answered question, decision receipt, merge line, blocked promotion) stamped before the conversation was created. `'head'` placement remains only for a record after its creation but older than its oldest loaded page. Open items are still drawn. A successor's handoff note card shows one line counting the decisions and merges before it, linking to the previous coordinator. The same rule ships in web (`decisionReceiptAnchor` and its callers), iOS/macOS (`ReceiptAnchor.place`) and Android.
acceptanceCriteriaItems.verificationMethod: Unit tests in all three clients over the same fixture: a record before createdAt is not placed, a record after createdAt but older than the loaded page goes to head, an open question asked before createdAt is still drawn, and the note card line reads its count. Reviewer checks that the three tests share the fixture's cases and pass.

acceptanceCriteriaItems.text: A successor coordinator opens with a dated state digest rendered by the server: one line per task and per acceptance criterion, open items, and live owner rulings, at most 16,000 characters for a project of 40 tasks. Its opening no longer requires project_get and task_list before the first report, and still says a later read wins over the digest.
acceptanceCriteriaItems.verificationMethod: Apiserver spec rendering the digest for a 40-task fixture project, asserting its sections and length ≤ 16,000 characters, and asserting the opening text. Evidence includes one real handoff on a test project showing the successor's first-turn context tokens below the measured v1 baseline of 58k for this project shape, or explaining the difference.

heldUpBy.title: Successor coordinator opens with a server-rendered state digest

acceptanceCriteriaItems.text: Owner rulings are project records. A `project_ruling` row holds the ruling sentence, the owner's quote, its source (an answered ask_owner question or a coordinator turn id), who recorded it, when, and an optional superseded-by. An answered ask_owner question becomes a ruling automatically. A coordinator records a chat ruling with `project_ruling_record`, refused unless the quote is a substring of that turn's owner text. The handoff note turn first asks the outgoing coordinator to record unrecorded rulings, and the note's section is named "Rulings not yet recorded". The project page on web lists live rulings under the criteria.
acceptanceCriteriaItems.verificationMethod: Migration plus apiserver pg specs: auto-ruling on answer, quote substring check accepts and refuses, supersession, owner scoping. Spec on the note prompt's text and sections. Web test of the project page list. Reviewer reads specs and passing output.

heldUpBy.title: Owner rulings as project records (project_ruling, project_ruling_record)

acceptanceCriteriaItems.text: End to end on a deployed build: a real handoff of a test project's coordinator while a `delegate` run and a `schedule_wakeup` are pending. The successor receives both, its conversation starts with the note card and no earlier records, its opening carries the digest, and a ruling recorded before the handoff appears in the digest.
acceptanceCriteriaItems.verificationMethod: Walkthrough evidence: screenshots of the confirm dialog listing the pending items and of the successor's conversation, plus the successor's transcript showing both wakes and the digest. Judged against this criterion's text by a session that did not do the work.

heldUpBy.title: Walkthrough: a real coordinator handoff with pending work, on a deployed build
